Two-Period Design Response Spectrum
figures.description: The two-period design response spectrum (Section 11.4.5.2): design spectral acceleration Sa vs structural period T, defined by SDS (short-period plateau), SD1 (1-s constant-velocity branch SD1/T), corner periods T0 = 0.2*SD1/SDS and Ts = SD1/SDS, and the long-period transition TL beyond which Sa = SD1*TL/T^2.
